packageRules.description: Group pyproject.toml dependency bumps so pixi.lock is regenerated once
Changing the supported Python version is a project decision, not a routine bump. Covers both requires-python and the pixi python pin

Hold new releases for 14 days so a compromised or broken release has time to be caught. The conda datasource provides no release timestamps, and minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour defaults to timestamp-required, so including it would suppress conda updates indefinitely rather than delay them. A cooldown for conda packages and for the transitive pins in pixi.lock has to come from pixi's own exclude-newer instead
